function.text: PHOX2B encodes paired mesoderm homeobox protein 2B. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Haddad syndrome (autosomal dominant); central hypoventilation syndrome, congenital, 1, with or without Hirschsprung disease (autosomal dominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
